title: Appendix 2A-b — Schedule of Tariff Commitments of the United Kingdom
note: The United Kingdom's commitments on originating goods of India. Commodity codes are 2022 nomenclature.

A.label: Duty-free from entry into force
A.detail: Customs duty eliminated on the date the agreement entered into force. No phase-in, no quota: an originating good of India in this category enters the United Kingdom at nil duty today.

TRQ.label: Tariff rate quota
TRQ.detail: Duty-free only within an annual quota, and only for goods within the stated value bands. There is no preferential out-of-quota rate — once the quota is exhausted the good pays the full UK Global Tariff rate.

U.label: Excluded from the agreement
U.detail: Excluded from any commitment to reduce or eliminate customs duty. The UK Global Tariff rate applies in full, and no CETA preference can be claimed. Claiming one on an entry for a good in this category is a false declaration.

trq.title: Electric, hybrid and hydrogen passenger cars (HS 8703)
notes: The quota table begins at year six. For years one to five the United Kingdom opens no quota at all.
Annex 2A Section D paragraph 2(c): there is no out-of-quota preferential customs duty for these codes. Outside the quota the full UK Global Tariff rate applies.
Cars above £80,000 CIF are marked U in every year — excluded from the quota for the life of the agreement.
Annex 2A Section D paragraph 2(d): the values in the quota are not adjusted for inflation.
Annex 2A Section A paragraph 2: year one runs from entry into force on 2026-07-15 to 31 December 2026; each later year is the calendar year beginning 1 January.
